name: Commerce KNET
description: Off-site redirect Commerce payment gateway for KNET, Kuwait's national debit-card network. At checkout the shopper is redirected (browser GET) to the KNET hosted payment page; KNET POSTs back an AES-128-CBC-encrypted trandata response that the module decrypts with the merchant terminal resource key and validates server-side (result CAPTURED, order id, amount) before recording a completed Commerce payment. No card data is stored on the Drupal side. Note: the bundled SecureText helper uses PHP-7 curly-brace string-offset syntax that is a parse error on PHP 8, so the encrypt/decrypt paths fatal on Drupal 10/11 until patched.
php_requirement: >=7.4.0 declared in composer.json; note the SecureText helper's curly-brace string-offset syntax is a parse error on PHP 8.0+, which Drupal 10/11 require
project_description:
Commerce KNET is Drupal Commerce 

module that integrates the KNET payment

gateway into your Drupal Commerce shop.
